title: HelperSessionTargetParams
description: Mints a one-shot target from a retained snapshot: which rows, and which of the four kinds the agent rule names for them (nocx-6q1uh.5, spec §6.2, §6.3). It carries no includeCursor: that property follows from kind alone — only 'input' targets carry the caret into their digest — so a field this op would silently ignore is refused by the contract rather than offered.

kind.description: One of the closed set spec §6.3 names: menu (question through the last option), input (the input box, cursor included), working (the menu zone), region (the whole visible screen or named rows).
